mapper.select: SELECT id, project_id, name, center_lat, center_lng, radius, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at FROM t_attendance_area WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY id
SELECT id, project_id, name, center_lat, center_lng, radius, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at FROM t_attendance_area WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_attendance_area (project_id, name, center_lat, center_lng, radius, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{name}, #{centerLat}, #{centerLng}, #{radius}, 0, NOW(), NOW())
